V3.result: Offline gates passed but were in-sample. External audit found 7 blocking defects.
blocking_defects: D5 claims CONTINUE-correct but ANSWER succeeds under executor
P3 claims CONTINUE-correct but ANSWER has highest utility
Controller and executor answer semantics disagree
V3 ANSWER certificate accepts competing verified support
V3 FALSIFIED semantics disagree with canonical viability

V3R.result: All 8 structural holdout gates pass with 0% feature overlap. VHA ablation shows VHA is needed for ANSWER coverage.

vha_ablation.V3R2_A_with_vha: PASS (all 8 gates, ANSWER cov=30/60, DEFER cov=92/120)
vha_ablation.V3R2_B_without_vha: FAIL (G5 only: ANSWER coverage=0/60 — VHA needed for ANSWER authority)
vha_ablation.interpretation: verified_hyp_action is needed for ANSWER authority coverage. Without it, the model cannot distinguish ANSWER-correct from DEFER-correct post-verification states. This is a benchmark shortcut limitation, not an oracle leak.

semantic_fixes: FALSIFIED means proposition failed, not hypothesis falsified
ANSWER certificate requires unique verified support + no competition
DEFER certificate rejects competing verified support
Executor ANSWER success requires unique supported hypothesis
P3/D5 have real continuation paths (unverified discriminator)
Structural holdout: different n_hyps/budgets/topology patterns (0% feature overlap)
Fail-closed data loader (I3.28B/C explicitly excluded, documented)
limitations: verified_hyp_action creates a benchmark shortcut (observable but limits scientific claim)
